decisions.reason: After several years without visible evidence of traction, this conferencing offer appears to fall short of aspiration levels and is less central than infrastructure-led services, so resources are better redirected.
Its earlier adoption signal and strong fit with the firm's network, data-centre and cloud-connectivity strengths keep expected performance above aspiration, making withdrawal unlikely.
Optical spectrum connectivity uses the firm's owned fibre assets and supports its move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure, so management would tolerate uncertainty and retain it.

With no clear success signal after launch and with enterprise telecom demand shifting toward more integrated data and cloud services, this voice-adjacent product is more likely to be judged below aspiration and discontinued.
